This layout keeps your three real strength days on non-consecutive days, preserves three direct run exposures plus one weekly 20 kg ruck, and keeps squat/deadlift in maintenance while the Tuesday run does the main 3K-specific work.

Weeks 2-4: the Tuesday run progresses by extending rep duration before Week 4 slightly sharpens pace with lower total work. Squat, deadlift, and most easy running stay intentionally stable unless recovery is clearly excellent.

If shin irritation returns, repeat the last symptom-free week and first reduce the most recently increased impact stressor: usually the Tuesday interval progression; if symptoms show up after the ruck, hold or slow the ruck pace before changing run volume. If Friday feels too crowded or your legs are beat up, cut the Pallof Press first, then the Chin-up, before touching the easy run.

Weekly running volume anchor: your established, tolerated baseline is about 18-20 km per week across 3 running exposures, and this block keeps 3 running exposures while quality becomes more 3K-specific. Easy-run durations are set at or slightly below that baseline on purpose, so the new interval specificity is the only impact variable stepping up. While shins and next-day soreness stay normal, rebuild toward the top of your 18-20 km range by adding a few minutes to the easy runs first, never by adding a fourth running day or by making the easy runs faster. If shin symptoms return, cut easy-run duration first, hold the newest interval and ruck progression, and repeat the last symptom-free week before progressing again.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP]	N/A	1	8 min	N/A	3	Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 47.5 kg x 5, 72.5 kg x 3, 92.5 kg x 1-2 before 120 kg work sets.; Ramp Weighted Pull-up: bodyweight x 5, +10 kg x 3, +20 kg x 2 before +27.5 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Mon	Back Squat	120 kg	2	3	3 min	7	Maintenance dose; crisp reps, no grinding.	
Mon	Weighted Pull-up	+22.5 kg	3	4	2.5-3 min	7-8	Start slightly below your demonstrated +30 x 5; add load only if all sets stay clean. Submaximal weighted pulling anchored below the demonstrated +30 kg x 5 benchmark; keep every rep strict.	
Mon	Push-up	Bodyweight	2	18	90 sec	7	Low-cost push support; stop 2-3 reps before form slips.	
Mon	Run	5:20-5:50/km	1	5 km	N/A	4-5	Easy conversational run; keep this truly relaxed.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Run	Easy jog + drills + 4 relaxed strides	1	2 km	N/A	3-4	Include easy jog, dynamic running drills, then strides before the work reps.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Run	1:43-1:45 per 400 m	5	400 m	90 sec jog	8	3K-specific intervals from current repeatable pace; finish with 1 km easy cooldown.	
Wed	[WARMUP]	N/A	1	8 min	N/A	3	Hip-hinge drill x 8; Glute bridge x 10; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Deadlift: 62.5 kg x 5, 92.5 kg x 3, 120 kg x 1-2 before 155 kg work sets.; Ramp Overhead Press: 22.5 kg x 5, 32.5 kg x 3, 42.5 kg x 1-2 before 55 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Wed	Deadlift	155 kg	2	3	3 min	7	Maintenance dose; fast bar speed, leave margin.	
Wed	Overhead Press	55 kg	3	5	2 min	7.5	Strict reps; no layback turning this into a push press.	
Wed	Pull-up	Bodyweight	4	8	2 min	7-8	Main bodyweight volume exposure; all reps clean from dead hang.	
Wed	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	35 sec/side	45 sec	6	Low-cost trunk support.	
Thu	Backpack Carry	20 kg at 9:20-9:30/km	1	8 km	N/A	5-6	Early developmental step toward the faster 10 km standard; brisk walk, no loaded running.	
Fri	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	8/side	75-90 sec	6-7	Support-only dose; if legs are heavy from the week, keep this conservative.	
Fri	Chin-up	Bodyweight	2	6	90 sec	6-7	Easy support pulling; smooth reps, plenty in reserve.	
Fri	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	10/side	60 sec	6-7	Brace hard; keep ribcage stacked and avoid trunk rotation.	
Fri	Run	5:20-5:50/km	1	6 km	N/A	4-5	Easy aerobic run; keep it relaxed enough to help recovery.	
END_WEEK1_TSV
